name: PILOT-F4-DEMORGAN
prompt_text:
Is the following equivalence true? 'Not both P and Q' is equivalent to 'not P or not Q'.
Answer with exactly one word: TRUE or FALSE.

name: PILOT-F4-TRAP-DEM
prompt_text:
Is the following equivalence true? 'Not (P or Q)' is equivalent to 'not P or not Q'.

name: PILOT-F4-DIST
prompt_text:

Answer with exactly one word: TRUE or FALSE.

name: PILOT-F4-TRAP-DIST
prompt_text:

name: PILOT-F4-CHAIN
prompt_text:
Not both P and Q. P holds. Does it follow that Q does not hold?
Answer with exactly one word: VALID or INVALID.

name: PILOT-F5-EXFALSO
prompt_text:
Suppose P holds and P also does not hold. Does it follow that an unrelated claim Q holds (in classical logic)?
Answer with exactly one word: VALID or INVALID.

name: PILOT-F5-SAT
prompt_text:

Answer with exactly one word: SAT or UNSAT.

name: PILOT-F5-TRAP-SAT
prompt_text:

Answer with exactly one word: SAT or UNSAT.

name: PILOT-F5-NEG
prompt_text:

name: PILOT-F5-TRAP-DNEG
prompt_text:

name: PILOT-F5-CHAIN
prompt_text:

name: PILOT-F6-TRAP-RES
